name: Ensembl genome registry, assemblies and gene annotation (human)

version.value: Ensembl release 116 (REST); integrated release 2026-07 in the genome selector

scope: Reference assemblies and annotation. 563 human genome records in the selector: GRCh38.p14 (reference, GENCODE annotation), GRCh37.p13, T2T-CHM13v2.0 and 560 haplotype assemblies.
mapping_methods: Stable Ensembl IDs with cross-references; liftover/assembly mapping through Ensembl tools.

licence.name: Ensembl imposes no restrictions on access to or use of the data (disclaimer page)
licence.redistribution: Unrestricted per the disclaimer; check third-party components

update_frequency: Integrated releases several times a year (2026-07 live).
coverage_limitations: Only the genome registry and details for three assemblies are downloaded; no sequence or annotation files yet
known_omissions: Variation and regulation data exist for few of the 560 sample assemblies (96 with variation, 2 with regulation)

reuse_decision.rationale: Registry already collected and verified; fetch FASTA/GTF only when an analysis needs them, preferring GENCODE/MANE files already staged for acquisition.

status.notes: REST and FTP reachable. The web docs for VEP plugins returned HTTP 504 at probe time.
